title: A Yearbook for the Semester
author: Jude Crane
blurb: Mirabel Brightwater, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must expose what the school board buried before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
